name: Gardevoir
description: It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: The user emits a powerful flash of light to inflict damage on the target.

moves.name: Confusion
moves.description: The target is hit with a weak telekinetic force to inflict damage.

moves.name: Teleport
moves.description: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, if there is any able to battle. If a wild Pokémon uses this move, it flees.

moves.name: Draining Kiss
moves.description: The user attacks with an energy-draining kiss that restores the user’s HP.

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.description: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target drowsy.

moves.name: Calm Mind
moves.description: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its offensive and defensive stats.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Aura Sphere
moves.description: The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Moonblast
moves.description: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target’s offensive stats.

moves.name: Recover
moves.description: The user regenerates its cells to restore its own HP.
